create_FixedWindowIndexer: create a FixedWindowIndexer with a fixed window size for rolling window calculations on a DataFrame
create_VariableOffsetWindowIndexer: create a VariableOffsetWindowIndexer using a DatetimeIndex and a DateOffset for variable-width rolling windows
create_GroupbyIndexer: create a GroupbyIndexer to compute rolling window bounds grouped by categorical labels
create_ExpandingIndexer: create an ExpandingIndexer to compute expanding window bounds for cumulative aggregations
create_FixedForwardWindowIndexer: create a FixedForwardWindowIndexer for forward-looking rolling windows starting at the current row
